title: Haven By The Sea | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Haven By The Sea is a 3.00 bedroom, 2.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Welcome to Haven By The Sea in Grayton Beach! This professionally furnished 4 bedroom/2.5 bath home is situated in an ultra-exclusive gated community just off of 30A, giving our guests the privacy they need without sacrificing the convenience of location. This secluded paradise has got everything you need for a relaxed stay; up to 8 people will be spaciously accommodated in this home. Upstairs and downstairs patios give a handful of options for enjoying a morning cup of coffee. For eating indoors, the 4-seat peninsula and 8-seat dining area are the perfect set-ups for sharing laughs and making memories with your favorite people!On the first floor, you'll find a bright and airy space where the living area flows into the kitchen and dining areas. Relax on the sofa in the living area, where a TV awaits to entertain you after a day of seaside activities. The kitchen features modern appliances, including a washer and dryer for added convenience, as well as a standard coffee maker, Keurig, oven, microwave, and refrigerator, ensuring your stay is both comfortable and hassle-free.Head upstairs to find four cozy bedrooms, each offering comfortable beds, private bathrooms, and entertainment with their own TVs. Don't forget to step out onto the private balcony for a spot to enjoy your morning brew. Perfect for creating lasting memories on your family getaway! Book now for an unforgettable experience!Sleeping Arrangements:2nd floor, Bedroom 1: 2 twin single beds.2nd floor, Bedroom 2: King bed, tv.2nd floor, Bedroom 3: King bed, tv, private bathroom.2nd floor: Twin-over-twin bunk bed is located in the hallway and no door with tv, closet, private balcony access, private bathroom.Beach Access:Exit the neighborhood and cross 30A. To the west of Sanctuary by The Sea complex you'll find your gated walkway to the beach. Once down the pathway, head right towards the public beach or on your left past the sections of private beach you'll find Grayton Beach State Park.Preserve at Grayton Beach:The Preserve at Grayton Beach is an ultra-exclusive, gated community right on Scenic 30A. This neighborhood features custom built beach-chic homes with state-of-the-art amenities and inclusions. In one of these meticulously appointed homes, you’ll find yourself surrounded by one-of-a-kind beauty that is unsurpassed in every sense. Enjoy 2 community pools (1 heated seasonally) and tennis courts. The location puts you within walking or biking distance from all the area's popular spots. From ice cream to shopping, you'll find it in the Grayton Beach and Blue Mountain Beach areas.* Sorry, no pets allowed.* Parking for 3 cars.* Special note: The heated community pool follows a seasonal schedule that may be adjusted by the HOA. Heating is not guaranteed, and we are not responsible if the pool is not heated during the specified period.An initial starter kit of amenities is provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.Your stay at Haven By The Sea comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!
